mapping_json.fidelity_notes: TWO-STEP PLANT-THEN-DETONATE: slam raises rock spikes -> warcry detonates all spikes for the payoff (dossier skill_loop; mech_note 'plant-then-detonate slam loop'). This maps as a mark-apply/consume PAIR: the spikes are placed markers (mark:consumption) applied by the slam, then consumed by the warcry for burst-damage (trigger_grammar apply-consume-pair, consequence burst-damage; proc_trigger_condition on-cast-linked = the warcry-cast triggers the consume). MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH=1 respected: slam-applies -> warcry-consumes is a single apply-consume pair, not a nested chain. The spike-COUNT accumulation (up to 15-18) is also an accumulator (fill on-hit-dealt per fissure). Geometry ground_slam (§6). PHYSICAL RULE -> element-neutral; stun (physical-slam archetype, minimal). T4 GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION_cascade (the shatter-all-spikes-at-once propagation across the field) + GEOMETRY_COLLAPSE alt. CAPSTONE ABSTAINED — t4 routed from core identity (spike-field-then-shatter propagation) + probe (physical/cooldown) per fallback. PHANTOM ALIAS: verify_ledger/item_alterations logs 'Foulborn Ghostwrithe zerker(3.28)' as an unadjudicated alias with NO matching item found — NOT treated as a source fact (per batch-03 note 2); no mapping consequence. Warcry+Rage is the Berserker delivery flavor (self_buff + rage-builder rider), the two-step slam is the dominant loop.
